content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Status: missing (insert)** — Paragraph 4(c) of the Kubient agreement covers only cessation of Services, licence revocation, and mutual return-or-destruction of Confidential Information. There is no transition assistance, no data return/export in a usable format, and no deletion certification anywhere in the document, and the "return or destroy" election would let Kubient destroy AP's data outright on termination.

**Redline (validated, preferred position):** new paragraph 4(c)(v) requiring Kubient to (A) provide up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates on request, (B) return all Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and (C) thereafter delete it and certify deletion in writing — with the 90-day/30-day fallback flagged in the comment as a landing zone.
